metadata.description: MCP connectors and Claude Code plugins for Gulf/MENA businesses and infrastructure teams

plugins.name: gulf-business
plugins.description: Gulf & MENA business toolkit for Claude: GCC VAT, ZATCA e-invoice QR, IBAN and VAT-number validation, Hijri dates, working days, Arabic amount in words (tafqeet).

plugins.name: infra-audit
plugins.description: Passive website & infrastructure audit for Claude: TLS certificates, security headers, SPF/DMARC/DKIM, DNS/CAA and end-of-life software, with a graded report and fixes.

plugins.name: business-db
plugins.description: Safe read-only business database connector for Claude: ask questions of SQLite/PostgreSQL data with engine-level write blocking, row limits, PII masking and table allow/deny lists.
